source: Mars Odyssey Gamma Ray Spectrometer element concentration maps, 5x5 degree bins smoothed with a boxcar filter (ODY-M-GRS-5-ELEMENTS-V1.0, NASA PDS Geosciences Node). Boynton et al. (2007), JGR 112, E12S99.
note: Gamma rays sample roughly the top few tens of centimetres. Non-radioactive elements are masked poleward of ~60 degrees because of polar hydrogen and CO2 frost.
